svg.title: Animated ReAct versus Tura patch workflow
svg.desc: A black terminal-style animated comparison. ReAct runs search, patch, build, test and lint through repeated model turns on the left. Tura runs the same dependency-aware process inside one command_run call on the right. Benchmark input tokens, output tokens, rounds and modeled cost appear at the end.

g.text: Patch command_run handler and complete CI verification
search → apply_patch → cargo build → cargo test → cargo clippy
find handler implementation and related files
PATCHED · BUILD OK · TESTS OK · LINT OK
DONE — 1 model turn, runtime executed the full graph
includes fixed 2.4K system prompt per model entry · $5/M input + $30/M output
same engineering work · fewer model round trips · animation restarts automatically
